rca of the issue: Repro: open Bead Journey -> click any rail bead (manual select) -> click Play bead journey -> wait >5s. Active tab remains unchanged. Expected: auto-advance resumes every 5s while section is visible and not hovered. Likely cause: pause/focus state interplay in useVisibleSequence events keeps playing=false after manual interactions; Play button visual state changes but interval path does not execute.
